quote: Except for the traditional multichannel video delivery business, which requires significant capital investment to serve customers, the barriers to entry are not high, and technology changes force rapid competitive adjustments.
why: "barriers to entry are not high"と参入障壁の低さを自ら記述。顧客が乗換で費用を負う機構の名指しは無い→50

quote: PASS agreements automatically terminate without refund should owners not purchase any offered season tickets.
why: 席権保有者は季節券を買い続けないと"terminate without refund"で払込金を失う＝顧客が負う複数年の購買義務（2会場のみ）→70

quote: The hotel industry is highly competitive.
why: "highly competitive"という一般的な競争記述のみで、宿泊客の乗換費用を示す機構の名指しは無い→50

quote: These contracts generally may be terminated without cause by either party on 60 to 90 days' notice or on 30 days' notice if we have not complied with certain licensing, certification, program standards, Medicare or Medicaid requirements or other regulatory requirements.
why: 支払者契約は"terminated without cause"・"60 to 90 days' notice"で解約でき、顧客側の乗換費用は無い→50

quote: The localized nature of the business makes these markets highly competitive and competition is generally based on reliable product delivery, product availability, technical support, quality and price.
why: "highly competitive"で競争は"price"等で決まると記述。ボンベ賃貸はあるが顧客の乗換費用は書かれていない→50

quote: The restaurant industry is intensely competitive with respect to the type and quality of food, price, service, restaurant location, personnel, brand, attractiveness of facilities, and effectiveness of advertising and marketing.
why: "intensely competitive"で味・価格・立地等で競うとの一般的記述のみ。来店客の乗換費用の機構は無い→50

quote: This customer may endeavor to replace our products in some or all markets, with lower-priced products supplied by others or may otherwise reduce its purchases of our products.
why: 最大顧客が"replace our products"で他社の"lower-priced products"へ移り得ると記述＝乗換費用は顧客を縛らない→50

quote: The principal methods of competition in our business include customer service, product offerings, availability, quality, price and store location.
why: 競争の手段は"customer service"や"price and store location"という一般的記述で、乗換費用の機構は無い→50

quote: Sprint is further prohibited from, directly or indirectly, contracting for, or launching, any wireless communications network that provides PCS services in the Market until the termination of the Strategic Network Alliance, including all renewals thereof.
why: 卸の最大顧客Sprintは提携終了まで他網の"contracting for"を"prohibited"＝顧客が複数年の縛りを負う→70

quote: Since each exchange is built based on industry standards, the system/exchange interfaces can be built by the Company or any other third party vendor, at the client’s option.
why: 接続は"industry standards"準拠で"any other third party vendor"も構築できる＝顧客を当社に縛る組込ではない→50

quote: The typical license agreement requires that the licensee pay us the greater of a royalty based on a percentage of the licensee’s net sales of licensed products or a guaranteed annual minimum royalty that typically increases over the term of the license agreement.
why: ライセンシーは契約期間中"guaranteed annual minimum royalty"を払う義務＝顧客が負う複数年の購買義務（ライセンス部門のみ）→70

quote: Our agreements with these insurance company suppliers are generally subject to cancellation by either party upon 30 to 90 days' notice.
why: 保険会社との契約は"30 to 90 days' notice"で"cancellation"でき、顧客側の乗換費用は無い→50
